determinism_and_boundaries: The analyzer parses source with ast and never executes the source it examines.
Results sort facts by stable symbol ID and reject duplicate logical bindings instead of inventing an identity.
The shared frontend owns parsing, lexical scopes, declarations, diagnostics, and unsupported-construct notices; the analyzer adds only semantic-index projection.
Dynamic execution, reflection, constructed attributes, native boundaries, monkey patches, metaclass mutation, and runtime code generation downgrade confidence rather than being claimed exact.
The compiler is bounded Python AST analysis, not whole-CPython semantic equivalence, runtime tracing, M2/M3 mutation, a proof system, or a canonical PCSM source-map authority.
selected_existing_authority.minimum_delta_reason: The current datasets implementation already provides the required Python-v1 compiler, versioned schema, CID-bound source/symbol identities, fail-closed dynamic-feature classification, and positive/negative test coverage. A new proof_context implementation would duplicate its authority and violate the exact receipt-only edit boundary.

The exact input source emitted a CID and the symbol emitted both a stable ID and version CID bound to the selected schemas.

limitations: This task is receipt-only: it selects existing current-head compiler authority and does not create a competing compiler or mutate proof_context/.

The selected compiler is a bounded static Python AST analysis. It does not execute source and cannot establish whole-CPython runtime semantics, dynamic import results, reflection, native behavior, or generated-code correctness; these inputs are explicitly downgraded or rejected.

The source/symbol CIDs are valid only under the bound datasets source digests and stated schema/version; a changed source, canonicalization profile, schema, extractor version, or tree invalidates this receipt.
Provider test passes are simulated evidence only. The authoritative sealed suite remains unavailable because anyio is absent, so this receipt cannot promote completion.
The receipt's own canonical storage CID is unavailable because minting a self-describing CID would change its bytes.

rollback.procedure: Revert only this receipt and invalidate consumers of this PCSM compiler selection. Do not alter the selected datasets source forest, protected policy documents, or prior admitted history.
rollback.freshness_requirement: Do not reuse this receipt after any bound tree, gitlink, source digest, scheduler binding, compiler schema/version, identity profile, or validation-environment capability changes.
